I build AI workflows that ship, and I have been doing it for three years.

At Redwood, I built FlareGuard, an AI content validation workflow that cut escalations by 70–80%. Your role asks for someone to deliver AI enablement, build bespoke workflows, and assess team needs to scope improvements. I have done exactly that—consulting, building, and shipping across business units. I would welcome the conversation.
